# University of Sydney Library

> The University of Sydney Library provides comprehensive academic resources, digital collections, special collections, and research support services for students and faculty.

The library operates multiple locations including Fisher Library and the Susan Wakil Health Building Library, offering access to rare books, manuscripts, digital archives, and specialized support through librarians and peer learning advisors. The collection spans historical documents, cultural heritage materials, and subject-specific resources across disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Special Collections

## Collections & Archives

- [Digital Collections](https://digital.library.sydney.edu.au): Digital collections platform featuring historical documents, manuscripts, and cultural heritage materials
- [The Henry Lawson collection](https://library.sydney.edu.au/browse/special-collections/henry-lawson): Henry Lawson rare books and manuscripts collection featuring Australian literature
- [Teaching with Special Collections](https://library.sydney.edu.au/support/teaching/teaching-with-special-collections): Guide for integrating rare books and special collections into academic teaching

## Subject Resources & Research Guides

- [Medicine and health](https://library.sydney.edu.au/browse/medicine-and-health): Medicine and health resources including databases, clinical guidelines, and research guides
- [Conferences and non-traditional research outputs](https://library.sydney.edu.au/support/publishing/conferences-and-non-traditional-research-outputs): Guide on research outputs beyond journal articles and conference paper publishing

## Support & Services

- [Librarians](https://library.sydney.edu.au/about/contact/librarians): Contact information and booking appointments with subject librarians
- [Peer Learning Advisors](https://library.sydney.edu.au/about/contact/peer-learning-advisors): Information about Peer Learning Advisors providing study and referencing support
- [Add and edit items](https://library.sydney.edu.au/support/teaching/reading-lists-for-academic-staff/add-and-edit-items): Self-help guide for academic staff to add and edit items in reading lists

## About & Governance

- [About](https://library.sydney.edu.au/about): About page covering library services, governance, and contact information
- [Collection guidelines](https://library.sydney.edu.au/about/governance/collections-framework/collection-guidelines): Collection management guidelines for acquisition, retention, and budget decisions

## News & Stories

- [Behind the scenes with Live Chat](https://library.sydney.edu.au/about/news/bts-live-chat): Behind-the-scenes article about Library's Live Chat support service and operations
- [Fisher Library roof terrace](https://library.sydney.edu.au/stories/fisher-roof-terrace): Story about Fisher Library's roof terrace renovation and student campaign
- [Resilient Resonance exhibition at the Conservatorium Library](https://library.sydney.edu.au/about/news/resilient-resonance): News about Conservatorium Library exhibition on bamboo music from Philippines
- [Your Library Adventure Passport](https://library.sydney.edu.au/about/news/adventure-passport): News about Library Adventure Passport gamification program for student engagement
